integrity: Proof uses an exact derangement-bijection, conjugacy symmetry, and complete cycle-type representative breadth-first searches, independently executed in Python and C++17 using standalone sources.
scientific_limitations: All complete-distance computations are finite and cover crowns with part sizes from four through nine only; no higher-order or mixing-time theorem is claimed. Equivalent data in unindexed computational literature could exist. Publication priority and independent scientific validation are not established.
title: The ten-switch diameter and inverse antipodes of the nine-pair crown graph
